milestoneTitle: M1: 可信完成与统一账本 (Trustworthy Completion + Unified Ledger)
milestoneAcceptance: 同一任务在桌面、CLI、MCP、daemon 中状态一致
严格审计任务缺证据时，所有完成入口均拒绝完成
验证失败、旧版本证据和直接更新状态不能绕过门禁
个人待办仍能正常手动完成
存储迁移有可复查的对账与恢复方案

subTasks.evidence: lib/store.mjs: completeTask/markVerificationResult/updateTask({status:completed}) route through evaluateCompletion; 4 JSON regression tests pass
lib/postgres-store.mjs: completeTask gate + audit_reviews row on hold; 3 PG parity tests pass with mocked I/O
lib/codex-runner.mjs: executeTaskWithCodex propagates evidenceContract/auditLevel/evidenceContractSeen/verification on both success and failure paths

Sources/AxiTodoKit/AxiTodoGate.swift (mirror gate, 4 reasons) + AxiTodoModels (awaitingAudit status + 4 optional fields) + AxiTodoStore (saveTask/updateStatus demote to .awaitingAudit); Swift build + 11/11 AxiTodoStoreSmokeTests pass

test/completion-gate.test.mjs: 15 tests covering 缺证据/验证失败/旧版本证据/直接 update/个人手动 + parity tests; also updates existing evidence-guardrails (28/28 pass) + store-state-machine + store.test for new gate semantics

node --test on 8 test files: 86/86 pass; swift run AxiTodoStoreSmokeTests: 11/11 pass; F02 reproduction script (completion-gate-repro.mjs): both JSON daemon integration and PG mocked-I/O return awaiting_audit

Lore Commit Protocol commit (feat(axi-todo): scope) + ledger m1-entries.json reflects actual run state; pre-existing uncommitted changes outside M1 scope (backend/config.py, web features/) NOT included

newFindings: F02 root cause confirmed: PostgresTaskStore.completeTask had no gate at all (line 186-203); the JSON gate was also reading result.evidenceContract but codex-runner never propagated it — silent bypass

JSON store has 21 tasks (10 completed + 11 pending) in production ~/.axi-todo/tasks.json snapshot; PG has 33 tasks (12 failed + 3 completed + 5 cancelled + 2 running + 11 pending) — back-end is unified but pre-existing completed entries need a separate recheck run to label as 待复核 (out of M1 scope, recorded for M2)
JSON and PG currently use 0 ID overlap and divergent status sets — convergence is M2 scope (single canonical store)
AxiTodoExecutionStatus.from(status:domain:) needed explicit .awaitingAudit arm when adding the new status; otherwise Swift switch exhaustiveness breaks compile
scopeNotChanged: Did not modify backend/ or src/web/ pre-existing dirty work per '保留已有未提交修改'
Did not change AXI_TODO_STORE default (still 'postgres' per schema; runtime caller controls via env)
Did not migrate pre-existing 18 JSON-completed entries to awaiting_audit (M2 / recheck task)
remainingGaps: Old completed entries (10 JSON, 3 PG) need a follow-up recheck run that calls markVerificationResult with verification.passed and re-evaluates the gate — recorded as a separate operational task, not part of M1 commit
JSON and PG dual-ledger reconciliation is M2 scope; M1 only ensures both stores agree on gate semantics

MCP axi_todo_update_task path remains the only completion surface that bypasses MCP server's tool definitions (calls store.updateTask directly) — M1 fixed this surface via store.updateTask gate, but a future hardening could add a status enum check at the MCP layer
Personal desktop bridge (completePersonalTask) is already independent of the gate by design; no change needed
